body.statement: Conditional on \((M,\Omega)\), fixed \(q\), uniform sub-Gaussian moments, row-law factorization, conditional within-row block dependence, frontier variance nondegeneracy, and frontier score diffuseness imply \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n(a,b,c)}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}|\mathbb P_P(L/s\le z\mid M,\Omega)-\Phi(z)|\to0\) uniformly when \((a,b,c)\) ranges over a compact subset of \([1/2,1]\times(0,1]\times[0,1]\).
body.justification: A dependency-graph Lyapunov argument remains valid uniformly as the cohort and window exponents vary because the frontier weights are diffuse at their rescaled standard error.
body.gap: Available serial factor central limit theorems do not provide this compact-uniform exponent-indexed statement for deterministic causal-block masking.
body.consumer: The sharp-frontier achievability direction can focus on native-optimizer remainders rather than postulating a Gaussian leading score.

obligation.what_is_open: The compact-uniform conditional Lyapunov bound over the exponent-indexed classes.
obligation.obstruction: Frontier diffuseness is proved, but the same mismatch between unconditional and conditional tail control remains uniformly over the class.
obligation.attempted: Substituted the frontier weight bounds into the degree-bounded dependency-graph Lyapunov quantity and isolated the sole missing conditional moment premise.
obligation.partial_result:
On every compact exponent subset, frontier score diffuseness gives
\[
 \sup\frac{\sum_{j,s}w_{js}^2}{s^2}<\infty,
 \qquad
 \sup\frac{\max_{j,s}|w_{js}|}{s}\longrightarrow0.
\]
Under the proposed conditional sub-Gaussian assumption, the same degree-\(2q\) dependency-graph calculation gives
\[
 \sup\sum_{j,s}\mathbb E\!\left(\left|\frac{w_{js}\epsilon_{js}}s\right|^3\middle|M,\Omega\right)
 \le C_qK^3\sup\frac{\max|w|}{s}\sup\frac{\sum w^2}{s^2}\longrightarrow0,
\]
which is the compact-uniform Lyapunov reduction.  Conditional tail control is absent from the frozen primitives, so the target cannot yet be marked proved.
